rows.note: 『numerous and varied competitors at the national and local levels, ranging from large department stores to specialty shops』＝代替容易。配信契約は当社が対価を払って棚を確保する側で、顧客側の移行コストではない。

rows.quote: We face significant competition in the ethanol industry. ... No assurance can be given that our ethanol plants will be able to compete successfully or that competition from larger companies with greater financial resources will not have a materially adverse impact on the results of our ethanol operations.
rows.note: エタノール・DDG は完全なコモディティで価格が全て（原本も commodity prices への依存を繰り返し明記）。認定・移行障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: The U.S. lodging industry is highly competitive. Our hotels compete with other hotels for guests in each of their markets on the basis of several factors, including, among others, location, quality of accommodations, convenience, brand affiliation, room rates, service levels and amenities, and level of customer service.
rows.note: ホテルREIT。ブランドはMarriott/Hilton/Hyattから借りる側で、フランチャイズ契約はむしろ当社の売却・運営を縛る制約として記述。高い参入障壁の主張は立地の話で顧客側の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: Nevertheless, the retail apparel market is highly fragmented and competitive. We face a challenging macro-economic and retail environment that creates intense competition for business from department stores, specialty stores, discount stores, warehouse stores, other off-price retailers, and manufacturer-owned outlet stores, many of which are units of large national or regional chains that have substantially greater resources.
rows.note: 原本自身が市場を highly fragmented・intense competition と述べる。顧客(買い物客)側に移行コスト・再認定の記述は皆無で、探した語(qualif/certif/switching/sole source)は全てSOX証明書のヒットのみ。

rows.quote: We compete for collection accounts primarily on the basis of price and the quality of our services. From time to time, our competitors reduce the price of their services in an effort to expand market share or to win a competitively bid municipal contract.
rows.note: 収集契約は価格競争＋競争入札で、市町村契約は1〜5年で再入札(『which we generally secure by competitive bid』)。埋立許可の取得難は参入障壁であって顧客側の負担ではないので85にも70にも当たらない。

rows.quote: Furthermore, because our towers are strategically positioned and our customers typically do not relocate, we have historically experienced low tenant lease terminations as a percentage of revenue.
rows.note: 立地固着＋設備移設コストによる高摩擦移行困難＝70。顧客(通信事業者)が再認定・再試験をやり直すという記述は無く、認証はゾーニング許可＝当社が取得する側なので85には届かない。

rows.quote: We employ our vessels in a highly competitive market that is capital intensive and highly fragmented, and competition arises primarily from other vessel owners.
rows.note: 原本が highly fragmented・チャーターレートと船齢/仕様で競争と明記。船級証明(class certification)は当社が取得する側で規約の除外対象。長期チャーターは契約であって顧客側の再認定コストではない。

rows.quote: The fashion footwear and accessories industry is highly competitive and barriers to entry are low. Our competitors include specialty companies as well as companies with diversified product lines. The recent market growth in the sales of fashion footwear and accessories has encouraged the entry of many new competitors and increased competition from established companies.
rows.note: 会社自身が『barriers to entry are low』『many new competitors』と断定。移行障壁の記述は一つも無い。

rows.quote: We face competition across our product lines from other food companies with the primary methods and factors in competition being product quality, price, packaging, product innovation, nutritional value, convenience, customer service, advertising, and promotion.
rows.note: 価格・棚取りでの競争を原本が明記(『the ability to secure and maintain adequate retail shelf space』)。single sourceの記述は当社の調達側の話で顧客側ではない。ブランド主導で移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The markets for credit ratings, financial research, investment and advisory services, index-based products, and commodities price assessments and related news and information about the commodities markets are intensely competitive. S&P Ratings, S&P Capital IQ, S&P DJ Indices and C&C compete domestically and internationally on the basis of a number of factors, including the quality of its ratings, research and advisory services, client service, reputation, price, geographic scope, range of products and technological innovation.
rows.note: NRSRO登録は当社が取得する側(規約の除外)。スイッチングコスト・深い統合・顧客側の再認定の記述をMD&A/Item1/リスク要因まで走査して発見できず、原本が自ら『intensely competitive』『price』を挙げるため50。原本の印象(150年の実績・世界の金融インフラ)と刻みは乖離する。

rows.quote: Most SST products are listed by recognized building standards agencies as complying with model building codes and are specified by architects and engineers for use in projects they are designing.
rows.note: 設計者が図面へ指定する設計組込＝70。ただし建築コード評価機関の承認は当社が取得する側(『SST conducts extensive product testing, which is witnessed and certified by independent testing laboratories』)で、顧客が再認定をやり直す記述は無いので85には当たらない。

rows.quote: The higher education industry is highly competitive, but with no single participant possessing a significant market share. We compete for students with traditional public and private two-year and four-year degree-granting accredited colleges and universities, other proprietary degree-granting accredited schools and also alternatives to higher education.
rows.note: 原本が『no single participant possessing a significant market share』と断定。認証(accreditation)・Title IV certificationは当社がDepartment of Educationから取得する側で規約の除外対象。

rows.quote: In line with industry practice, new customers usually require that we pass a lengthy and rigorous qualification process at the customer's cost. Accordingly, it may be difficult or costly for us to attract new major customers.
rows.note: 認定の費用を負うのが顧客側だと原本が明言(at the customer's cost)＋『a requirement that we requalify can result in our losing sales to that customer』＝85の機構。ただし同じ10-Kが price erosion と『our customers may quickly diversify their sources of supply』も述べ、堀の主観は低い(moat5=2)。

rows.quote: Competitors include domestic and foreign producers of the same and similar products. The principal methods of competition are product performance and technology, price, delivery schedule, quality of services, and other terms and conditions.
rows.note: 『the same and similar products』を国内外の生産者が供給と原本が明記＝代替容易。航空宇宙(Spincraft)でも顧客による部品認定の記述は走査で見つからず、qualifiのヒットは全て年金/監査意見の non-qualified。

rows.quote: Revenues from our traditional voice services have been declining as customers have been switching to wireless or VoIP services provided by either us, cable or other Internet-based providers.
rows.note: 10-Kは競争の議論をAnnual Reportへ参照組込（『Information relating to competition in each of our operating segments is contained in the Annual Report』）で本文に持たない。本文で読めるのは顧客が他事業者・他技術へ移っている記述と churn 最小化の努力＝移行障壁の不在側。認証・再認定の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: There are relatively few barriers to entry in this market, so as this market continues to develop we expect the number of competitors to increase.
rows.note: ドメイン登録業。ICANN認定レジストラが1,400超と原本が明記し、参入障壁が低いと会社自身が断定。リセラー向け卸で価格競争。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The industries in which we operate are highly competitive, and we compete with thousands of companies that range from large multinational corporations to local manufacturers. Competition is generally on the basis of breadth of product offering, product innovation, price, quality, delivery, and service.
rows.note: コネクタ最大手で顧客との共同設計（『working with our customers in developing new products』）はあるが、顧客側の再認定・qualification の記述は全文走査で一件も無く、逆に『thousands of companies』『downward pressure on prices』と自認。regulation で50。

rows.quote: our strategy is to market our seat comfort products to the OEMs who then direct their suppliers, such as Johnson Controls and Lear Corporation, to work with us
rows.note: OEMが車両設計に組み込みTier1へ指名する形＋『Revenues from these expenditures are typically not realized for two to three years due to this development cycle』の長い評価期間で70。ただし『our strategy is to』の願望形で、Competition節は『most of which have the capability to manufacture competing products』『Business is typically awarded to the supplier offering the most favorable combination of cost, quality, timely delivery』と50側の記述も強い（境界事例）。顧客側の再認定の断定は無い。

rows.quote: Our standard franchise agreement typically has a term of 15 to 20 years and provides a franchisee with certain rights to terminate the franchise agreement before the end of the agreement under certain circumstances.
rows.note: 15-20年のフランチャイズ契約期間＋交換会員の年次留保約90%（『generally retain approximately 90% of such members each year』）＝契約と再フラグ化の摩擦で70。ただしCompetition節は『Competition is robust among the lodging brand franchisors to grow their franchise systems and retain their existing franchisees』と自認し、顧客側の再認定要件は無い。

rows.quote: We must also compete with a number of companies in the wood-alternative segment of the decking, railing, fencing and trim markets and with wood producers that currently have more production capacity than is required to meet the demand for such products.
rows.note: 木材および他の木材代替メーカーとの直接競合を原本が明記。最大の競合は在来木材そのもので『the resistance of many consumers and contractors to change from well-established wood products』＝摩擦は当社側にある向き。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: We compete in many product lines with numerous manufacturers, some of which have substantially larger operations and financial resources than us.
rows.note: 『Our products are sold in highly competitive markets throughout the world』と自認し、競争要因は製品革新・品質・価格・保証・棚割り。ディーラー網はあるが顧客側の再認定・切替費用の記述なし。

rows.quote: Contracts for software products and services are generally implemented over periods of three months to one year, with annually renewing maintenance and support update agreements thereafter. Although either the client or we can terminate these agreements, historically almost all support and maintenance agreements are automatically renewed annually.
rows.note: 地方自治体の基幹システムで、導入に3ヶ月〜1年＋データ変換を要し（『Virtually all of our clients contract with us for installation, training, and data conversion services』）、保守契約はほぼ全件が自動更新＝深い統合とスイッチングコストで70。ただしCompetition節は『the market is highly fragmented with a large number of competitors』と自認し、顧客側の再認定は無い。

rows.quote: Furnaces and appliances that burn propane will not operate on fuel oil and vice versa, and, therefore, a conversion from one fuel to the other requires the installation of new equipment.
rows.note: 顧客が燃料を替えるには設備を入れ替える必要があると原本が断定し、さらに『The Partnership owns most of these storage tanks and leases them to its customers』で当社所有タンクが顧客敷地に据わる＝実在の移行摩擦で70。ただし摩擦は燃料種の乗換に対するもので供給者の乗換ではなく、『Wholesale propane distribution is a highly competitive, low margin business』とも自認する境界事例。

rows.quote: Our major competitors for prestige and mass products include traditional department stores, specialty stores, drug stores, mass merchandisers and the online businesses of national retailers as well as pure-play e-commerce businesses. ... The market for salon services and products is highly fragmented.
rows.note: 小売。競合を百貨店・専門店・ドラッグ・量販・EC純粋事業者と広く列挙し、サロン市場は fragmented と明記。顧客の移行障壁は原本にゼロ（ロイヤルティ制度はコスト項目として出るのみ）。

rows.quote: Our main railroad competitor is Burlington Northern Santa Fe LLC. Its primary subsidiary, BNSF Railway Company (BNSF), operates parallel routes in many of our main traffic corridors. In addition, we operate in corridors served by other railroads and motor carriers.
rows.note: irr欄としては50——原本は主要回廊で並走するBNSFに加えトラック・艀・パイプラインとの代替競合を自ら述べ、顧客側の切替費用や認定の記述は一つも無い。ただし線路・用地という複製不能資産の主観的な堀は最大級（moat5=5）で、irrの刻みと主観の堀が正面から割れる対照事例。なお『potential new suppliers face high barriers of entry』は機関車メーカー＝当社の仕入先側の話で向きが逆。

rows.quote: The lime industry is highly regionalized and competitive, with quality, price, ability to meet customer demands and specifications, proximity to customers, personal relationships and timeliness of deliveries being the prime competitive factors.
rows.note: 原本が自ら「highly ... competitive」で価格が主要競争要因と述べる。高い参入障壁（高品質石灰岩鉱床の希少性・採掘許認可）の記述はあるが、これは供給側の障壁で顧客側の再認定・移行費用の記述は一つも無い。

rows.quote: The Company has hundreds of competitors worldwide.
rows.note: 原本のcertification記述はISO13485・CEマーク・FDA QSR＝すべて自社が取得する側で85の対象外。GPOが『undifferentiated commodities』化を進めるとも自認。顧客側の再認定・切替費用の記述を探したが無い。

rows.quote: Some of our competitors have achieved significant recognition for their brand names or have substantially greater financial, distribution, marketing, and other resources than we do.
rows.note: アクセサリー小売ブランド。『We face strong competition in each of the product lines and markets in which we compete.』と自認し、certificationの言及は契約製造業者側の製造認証と役員宣誓のみ。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: This platform strategy also enables our customers to leverage their qualification efforts onto successive product models.
rows.note: 顧客側にqualification effortsが存在すると原本が明言＝85の入口だが、断定は『同一プラットフォーム内で流用できる』であり、他社へ替えると顧客が再認定費用を負うとは書かれていない。むしろ『We regularly engage in new product qualification with our customers』『limited product qualification programs and a significant focus on price』＝各世代で競争が開き直る側の記述。よって70。

rows.quote: The markets in which our Olefins business operates are highly competitive. We compete on the basis of customer service, product deliverability, quality, consistency, performance and price.
rows.note: コモディティ石化。『Due to the commodity nature of many of our products, competition in these markets is based primarily on price』と自認。customer qualif検索で出たのは紛争鉱物のconflict free認証（不適合なら顧客が当社をdisqualifyし得る＝逆向き）のみ。

rows.quote: The specialty e-commerce and retail businesses are highly competitive. We compete with other retailers that market lines of merchandise similar to ours.
rows.note: 専門小売。原本のcertificationはSOX宣誓書のみ。ブランド・品揃えで競うと述べるが、顧客側の移行障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: We believe that new competitors face significant barriers to entry into many of our markets, including various government mandated certification requirements to compete in the aerospace markets in which we participate. Aerospace industry safety regulations and manufacturing standards demand significant product certification requirements, which form a basis for competition as well as a barrier to entry.
rows.note: 航空機の政府認証が参入障壁と明言し、OEMのengineering組織・technology roadmapとの整合で競うと述べる＝深い設計組込。ただし『顧客側が再認定・再試験をやり直す』断定が無く、規約の『参入障壁が高い業界だ』の一般論に留まるため85ではなく70。加えてOEM顧客自身が内製可能・競合が同時に顧客とも自認。

rows.quote: Given the highly fragmented nature of the water industry, the Water Infrastructure segment competes with a large number of businesses.
rows.note: 原本が市場をfragmentedと明言し多数の競合と競うと述べる＝規約(50)の残余刻みに合致。installed baseのアフターマーケット（部品・保守）はあるが、qualif検索は人材・SOX関連のみで顧客側の再認定記述は無い。

rows.quote: As a result, we believe that significant brand loyalty to products often continues after the loss of patent-based and regulatory exclusivity.
rows.note: 特許・規制独占が切れた後もブランド忠誠が続くと原本が断定し、家畜生産者は薬が総コストの小部分ゆえ実証済み製品に忠実、と切替抵抗の機構も述べる＝高摩擦。ただし認証・再認定の機構は無く（FDA/USDA承認は自社取得側）、『hundreds of other producers』『generic競争』も自認するため85ではない。

rows.quote: Our business segments operate in highly competitive markets. Many of our competitors, primarily in our Energy Segment, are significantly larger and have substantially more resources. Competition is based on a number of factors, including price.
rows.note: FY2015(2/28締)10-K。競争は品質・製品幅・価格・サービスで、顧客側の再認定の記述は皆無。'qualif'は全て人材/会計/前方言及の用法。NLI(原子力向け安全関連機器)の記述はあるが供給者認定の機構文なし。

rows.quote: The sale of women’s intimate and other apparel, personal care and beauty products and accessories through retail stores is a highly competitive business with numerous competitors, including individual and chain specialty stores, department stores and discount
rows.note: L Brands FY2014 10-K。小売でスイッチングコストの概念自体が無く、原本は多数競合との価格・立地競争を述べる。'certification'はSOX条項のみ。ブランド力は強いが irr の対象外。

rows.quote: The markets for our products are subject to competitive risks because these markets are highly price competitive
rows.note: Balchem FY2014 10-K。競争節は全3セグメントで多数の私企業競合と価格競争を明記。顧客先での application testing の記述はあるが費用負担は当社側で、顧客の再認定ではない。EPA/FDA登録は当社が取得する側。

rows.quote: The financial services industry is a highly competitive global industry.
rows.note: Franklin Resources FY2014 10-K。同節が米国内7,800本・海外70,200本の公募投信を挙げ多数供給者を自認。顧客(投資家)側の再認定に類する記述なし。

rows.quote: We face substantial competition in our industry, and consolidation among beverage alcohol producers, wholesalers, or retailers, or changes to our route-to-consumer model, could hinder the marketing, sale, or distribution of our products.
rows.note: Brown-Forman FY2015 10-K。上位10社で世界スピリッツの20%未満＝断片化を自ら記載、クラフト系新規参入の増加も明記。ブランドと熟成在庫は強いが移行障壁の記述はない。

rows.quote: The markets for our products and services are highly competitive. We compete with marketing services companies, credit card issuers, and data processing companies, as well as with the in-house staffs of our current and potential clients.
rows.note: Alliance Data FY2014 10-K。複数年契約・更新の記述はあるが、switching cost/顧客の再認定・移行費用の断定は探しても無い（switch/costly/embedded/barriers を走査）。内製との競合も自認。

rows.quote: The men's and women's apparel industries are highly competitive with fashion, selection, quality, price, location, store environment, and service being the principal competitive factors.
rows.note: Buckle FY2014(1/31締)10-K。アパレル小売で移行障壁の概念なし。長期の仕入契約も無いと明記。

rows.quote: Electronic water metering has lower barriers to entry which could affect the competitive landscape in North America.
rows.note: Badger Meter FY2014 10-K。競争は価格・技術・品質・サービスで、自ら参入障壁の低下を警告。自治体入札の価格競争も明記。顧客側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: The Engine Segment has been awarded the "standard position" (the OEM-designated preferred supplier of component systems available to the end-customer) at several major global commercial vehicle OEMs.
rows.note: BorgWarner FY2014 10-K。OEM指定の優先供給者地位と application engineering/program launch＝設計組込の型だが、顧客側が再認定費用を負うという断定は無い（OEMの内製化リスク・多数の独立供給者も自認）ので85には届かず70。

rows.quote: We compete in the leasing of office, retail and residential space with a considerable number of other real estate companies, some of which may have greater marketing and financial resources than are available to us.
rows.note: Boston Properties FY2014 10-K。競争要因は物件品質・賃貸条件・立地で、テナント側の再認定に相当する記述はない。

rows.quote: The women’s retail apparel industry is highly competitive. The Company believes that the principal competitive factors in its industry include merchandise assortment and presentation, fashion, price, store location and customer service.
rows.note: Cato FY2014(1/31締)10-K。ディスカウント・量販・百貨店と価格競争と明記。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The commercial real estate market is highly competitive. Numerous commercial properties compete with us for tenants.
rows.note: COPT FY2014 10-K。SCIF/ATFP対応の特殊空間という差別化の自己記述はあるが、テナント側が移転時に再認定費用を負うという断定は無い（security clearance/relocat も走査）。競争節は明確に50側。

rows.quote: The Company believes that competition for the acquisition and operation of grocery-anchored shopping centers is highly fragmented.
rows.note: Cedar Realty FY2014 10-K。原本が自ら fragmented と述べる＝規約の残余刻み50の典型。参入障壁の言及は用地取得の難しさ(自社にとっての不利)の文脈。

rows.quote: The machine vision market is fragmented and Cognex’s competitors are typically other vendors of machine vision systems, controllers, and components; manufacturers of image processing systems, sensors, and components; and system integrators.
rows.note: Cognex FY2014 10-K。会社自身が市場を fragmented と明言し価格浸食も警告。standardiz/installed base/switch/qualif を走査したが顧客側の再認定・組込ロックの記述は無い（single sourceは自社の部品調達側＝向きが逆）。

rows.quote: Relatively few barriers to entry exist in the majority of markets served by VITAS.
rows.note: Chemed FY2014 10-K。VITASは自ら参入障壁が低いと述べ、Roto-Rooterも「fragmented in most markets」。Medicare COP等の認証は当社が取得する側で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: Competition in the Established Pharmaceutical Products segment is generally from other health care and pharmaceutical companies. In addition, the substitution of generic drugs for the brand prescribed and introduction of additional forms of already marketed established products by generic or branded competitors have increased competitive pressures.
rows.note: 全4セグメントの競争記述が技術革新・価格・製品性能の列挙で、後発品置換・private labelの圧力を自認。顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコストの記述は走査しても皆無（qualif/switching/installed base いずれもヒットなし）。

rows.quote: The market for personal and commercial residential property insurance is highly competitive. In our primary market, Florida, there are over 165 licensed insurance companies that write homeowners' policies.
rows.note: フロリダに165社が同種の保険を書くと自認＝断片化した価格競争市場。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The markets for our products and services are characterized by intense competition, new industry standards, evolving business and distribution models, disruptive software and hardware technology developments, frequent new product introductions, short product life cycles, price cutting with resulting downward pressure on gross margins and price sensitivity on the part of consumers.
rows.note: COMPETITION全文は激しい競争・無料製品・価格下落圧力を自認。『No single company has offerings identical』という差別化の記述はあるが、顧客側のスイッチングコスト・再認定の記述は一つも無い（barriers to entry/switching は不在）。

rows.quote: Our isolators have been designed into hundreds of applications, such as universal serial bus isolation in patient monitors, where it allows hospitals and physicians to adopt the latest advances in computer technology to supervise patient health and wirelessly transmit medical records.
rows.note: 顧客設計への組込（designed into）＋『Our analog ICs typically have long product life cycles』で高摩擦。ただし顧客が再認定をやり直すという断定は無く85には届かない。

rows.quote: Our success, therefore, depends in part on our ability to have end users specify that our products be used at their facilities. In addition, we may encounter difficulties in changing established relationships of competitors that already have a large installed base of products within such facilities. We must achieve design wins to retain our existing customers and to obtain new customers, although design wins achieved do not necessarily result in substantial sales.
rows.note: design win／installed base の摩擦は述べるが、主語は『我々の成功は…できるかに依存する』の願望形。copy exact への言及はあるが自社の部品供給者を認定する側の文脈で顧客側の負担ではない。競争節は『No single company dominates any of our markets』。

rows.quote: SMC operates in the fragmented and competitive telecommunication and infrastructure services industry. We compete with service providers ranging from small regional companies, which service a single market, to larger firms servicing multiple regions, as well as large national and multi-national contractors.
rows.note: EPC。fragmented を明記し、電力側もBechtel/Fluor等と入札競争・『Competition also places downward pressure on our contract prices and profit margins』。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The market for our services is intensely competitive and characterized by rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards and frequent new product and service innovations. We expect competition for our services to increase both from existing competitors and new market entrants.
rows.note: 更新時の単価下落（『a significant percentage of our renewals ... have involved unit price declines』）と顧客のdual vendor方針を自認。プラットフォーム規模は語るが顧客側の移行費用の記述は無い。

rows.quote: In general, most of AMETEK’s markets are highly competitive with competition based on technology, performance, quality, service and price.
rows.note: 航空では『50-plus years’ experience』『long-standing relationships』を強みに挙げるが、規約上は単なる長期取引で85にも70にも当たらない。qualif/FAA走査でも顧客側再認定の記述ゼロ。

rows.quote: Our tenants tend to renew leases because suitable alternative sites may not exist or be available and repositioning a site in their network may be expensive and may adversely affect the quality of their network. Historically, churn has been approximately 1% to 2% of total rental and management revenue per year.
rows.note: 顧客が移ると費用と品質劣化を負う＝高摩擦（churn1-2%の実数つき）。ただし第三者・顧客による再認定の機構は無く、別所で『our tenants have numerous alternatives in leasing antenna space』とも書くため85ではなく70。

rows.quote: Our Risk Solutions business operates in an environment that is highly competitive and very fragmented, and we compete with other global insurance brokers, including Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc. and Willis Group Holdings Public Limited Company, as well as numerous specialist, regional and local firms in almost every area of our business.
rows.note: 自ら very fragmented と明記。HR Solutions側も同様に強い競争。顧客側の移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The Company generally implements its product development strategy through product design teams and collaboration arrangements with customers, which result in the Company obtaining approved vendor status for its customers’ new products and programs.
rows.note: 顧客の承認済み供給者名簿（『OEM customers to consolidate their lists of qualified suppliers』）＋共同設計でapproved vendor status を得る型。だが顧客が乗換時に再認定費用を負うという断定は無いので70止まり。

rows.quote: The hotel industry is highly competitive. Each of the Company’s hotels is located in a developed area that includes other hotels and competes for guests primarily with other hotels in the Company’s immediate vicinity and secondarily with other hotels or lodging facilities in the Company’s geographic market.
rows.note: ホテルREIT。近隣ホテルとの代替競争を自認し、フランチャイズ免許は当社が受ける側。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The oil and natural gas industry is intensely competitive, and we compete with other companies in our industry that have greater resources than we do.
rows.note: コモディティ生産者。製品差別化・顧客側の認定という概念自体が原本に無い。

rows.quote: Once designed into a new aircraft, the spare parts business is frequently retained by the Company.
rows.note: 機体への設計組込＋アフターマーケット固着＝高摩擦。FAA走査ではFAAは顧客として登場するのみで、顧客側の再認定・型式認証の負担の記述は無い（Armstrongの certification solutions は当社が提供する役務）。

rows.quote: Substantially all of our apartment leases are for a term of one year or less. Because these leases generally permit the residents to leave at the end of the lease term without penalty, our rental revenues are impacted by declines in market rents more quickly than if our leases were for longer terms.
rows.note: 賃借人は違約金なしで退去できると自認＝移行障壁ゼロを原本が明言。競争も他REIT・戸建賃貸まで含む代替多数。

rows.quote: Competition in the telecommunications equipment and services industry is intense.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。Corning/OFS/AFL/Fujikura/Alcatel/TE等を名指しし、ケーブルアセンブリは『industry-standard or customer-specified configuration』。qualif系の走査で顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ＝代替容易の50。

rows.quote: We face significant competition in the markets we serve. The markets in which we operate are highly competitive. We compete worldwide with a number of other manufacturers and distributors that produce and sell similar products.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。競合はNavistar/Daimler/CAT/Volvo/Ford/Hino＋『OEMs who manufacture engines for their own products』。EPA/EU認証は当社が取得する側で除外。PACCARの長期供給契約は『particular engine requirements for specific vehicle models』止まりで顧客側の再認定の断定なし。

rows.quote: Once a product is designed into a system, customers may be reluctant to change the incumbent supplier due to the extensive qualification process and potential redesign required in using alternative sources.
rows.note: FY2014(7月期)10-K。設計組込後に代替供給源を使うと『extensive qualification process and potential redesign』が要ると断定＝負担は顧客側。ただし『may be reluctant』の緩和形で、85と70の境界寄り。

rows.quote: There are no other electric transmission and distribution utilities in CenterPoint Houston's service area. In order for another provider of transmission and distribution services to provide such services in CenterPoint Houston's territory, it would be required to obtain a certificate of convenience and necessity from the Texas Utility Commission and, depending on the location of the facilities, may also be required to obtain franchises from one or more municipalities.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K・Competition節。当該サービス地域に他の供給者が存在しないと原本が明言＝規約の100（規制上の領域独占）。ただし認定型の機構ではなく料金規制下。

rows.quote: The contact lens market is highly competitive.
rows.note: FY2014(10月期)10-K。J&J Vision Care・CIBA Vision・Bausch&Lombを最大競合と名指し。ISO13485/CEマークは当社が取得する側で除外。処方・フィッティングに関する顧客側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: The company operates in the highly competitive food industry and experiences international competition in all of its principal products. The principal areas of competition are brand recognition, taste, quality, price, advertising, promotion, convenience and service.
rows.note: FY2014(8月期)10-K。ジェネリック・PB品を含む多数の競合が価格・販促で競うと明言。知財も『not dependent upon any single patent』。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The infant and toddler consumer products industry is highly competitive.
rows.note: FY2015(3月期)10-K。ブランド品・PB品の双方と競合し、顧客(小売)からの値下げ圧力を自らリスクに挙げる。qualif・switch系の記述ゼロ。

rows.quote: Barriers to entry are relatively low, and new ventures to create products that do or could compete with our products are regularly formed.
rows.note: FY2014(7月期)10-K。参入障壁が低いと会社自身が二度断定し、アジア勢の価格競争にも言及。ADBEの『limited barriers to entry』と同型で50。

rows.quote: The operating environment in the deathcare industry has been highly competitive. Publicly traded companies operating in the United States include SCI, StoneMor and Carriage.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。障壁として挙げるのは『local heritage and tradition』＝地域評判であり顧客側の再認定ではない。火葬専業や低価格業者の新規参入も自認。

rows.quote: As a science and technology based company, DuPont competes on a variety of factors such as product quality and performance or specifications, continuity of supply, price, customer service and breadth of product line, depending on the characteristics of the particular market involved and the product or service provided.
rows.note: 原本はDuPont(CIK 30554)のFY2014 10-K。価格・品質・供給継続で競うと明言し、Solamet等は『intense competition has impacted price and share』。TiO2『world's largest manufacturer』は順位の自称で証拠にならない。顧客側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: The primary markets served by all Cintas operating segments are local in nature and highly fragmented. Cintas competes with national, regional and local providers, and the level of competition varies at each of Cintas' local operations.
rows.note: FY2014(5月期)10-K。市場はfragmentedと自認し競争要素は『Product, design, price, quality, service and convenience』。switch/qualif系の走査で顧客側の負担の記述ゼロ（唯一のqualifiedは自社の仕入先審査で向きが逆）。

rows.quote: We face substantial competition from a number of experienced companies, including state-sponsored entities and major shipping companies.
rows.note: FY2014 20-F。用船市場は『competitiveness of the bid in terms of overall price』で決まると自認。ISM/船級認証は当社(船)が取得する側で除外。

rows.quote: The airline industry is highly competitive, marked by significant competition with respect to routes, fares, schedules (both timing and frequency), services, products, customer service and frequent flyer programs.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。運賃競争とULCCの圧力を明記。FAAの運航証明は当社が取得する側で規約上除外。顧客側の移行費用の記述なし。

rows.quote: We compete with a number of developers, owners and operators of office and commercial real estate, many of which own properties similar to ours in the same markets in which our properties are located.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『similar to ours in the same markets』＝同等品が同一市場に存在。『high barriers to entry』は供給制約の submarket 選定の話で、顧客(テナント)側の負担は書かれていない。

rows.quote: Investing in senior living facilities, wellness centers, MOBs and other real estate is a highly competitive business.
rows.note: 原本はSenior Housing Properties Trust(CIK 1075415)のFY2014 10-K。取得競争・テナント獲得競争の記述のみ。Medicare/Medicaid certificationはテナント側が取得する規制免許で顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: We are facing increased competition in a number of our served markets as a result of the entry of new, large companies into certain markets, the entry of competitors based in low-cost manufacturing locations, and increasing consolidation in particular markets.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。Competition節は『highly competitive』『competitive position cannot be determined』で、競争要因に price・delivery speed を挙げる。顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコストの記述は全文走査でゼロ（qualification は自社の仕入先の複数認定の話のみ）。

rows.quote: In North America, Dolby Digital is the mandated audio standard for digital terrestrial and cable television.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。標準化団体・政府が用途（デジタル放送）ごとに当社技術を規格として指定済み＝第三者が用途を認定する型。ただし同10-Kは mobile について『not mandated as an industry standard』と明記し、そこでは『continually convince OEMs』＝願望形＝別格。放送は licensing 収入の43%。

rows.quote: We compete with numerous developers, owners and operators of real estate and datacenters, many of which own properties similar to ours in the same markets in which our properties are located, including DuPont Fabros Technology, Inc., CoreSite Realty Corporation, CyrusOne Inc., QTS Realty Trust, Inc. and various local developers
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。同等物件を持つ競合を実名で多数列挙。テナントの移設コスト・スイッチングコストの主張は relocat/switching 走査でも出ず。

rows.quote: Substantially all of our products are subject to competition with similar products manufactured by other manufacturers of aftermarket automotive repair and replacement parts.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『The replacement automotive parts industry is highly competitive』＋競争要因の筆頭が price。顧客（大手小売）が当社製品を直接調達しうるとも自認。

rows.quote: The market for supply chain technology is highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change. We expect that competition will increase in the future.
rows.note: 利用可能な提出書類が FY2005(2005-01-31期)の20-F 1本のみ＝原本が10年古い点は留保。当該原本は価格競争の激化を予想し、顧客が in-house 化や『switching to alternative providers』で離脱した実績まで書いている。

rows.quote: The restaurant business is highly competitive as to price, service, restaurant location, nutritional and dietary trends and food quality, and is often affected by changes in consumer tastes, economic conditions, population and traffic patterns.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。地場店・全国チェーン・QSR・食料品店まで競合と自認。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.note: FY2014 20-F。会社自身が市場構造を『highly fragmented』と明言＝規約の残余刻み50に一致。堀の主張はブランドと講師の質のみ。

rows.quote: The principal competitive factors in the epay Segment include price (that is, the level of commission paid to retailers for each transaction), breadth of products and up-time offered on the system.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。3セグメント全てで競合を実名列挙（Western Union/MoneyGram、銀行系ATM網、地場prepaid業者）。大手小売が手数料配分を要求できるとも自認＝価格競争。

rows.quote: The skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care businesses are characterized by vigorous competition throughout the world. Brand recognition, quality, performance, availability and price are some of the factors that impact consumers’ choices among competing products and brands.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。L'Oreal/Shiseido/P&G等を実名列挙し、小売のPB化も競合と自認。堀はブランドで、消費者側の移行障壁の記述はない。

rows.quote: “Special position” products are products that are also offered by competitors, but for which Eastman’s market position, regional cost advantage, and customer service provides a competitive advantage that enables consistent profit margins.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。製品ごとに principal competitors を実名で表にし、営業利益の15%未満は commodity と自認。Fibersの『significant barriers to entry』は高資本コストという一般論で、顧客側の負担は書かれていない（規約の85の除外に該当）。

rows.quote: The Company's businesses operate in end markets that are highly competitive. The Company competes based on product performance, quality, service and/or price across the industries and markets served.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。COMPETITION節は上記のみで、競合数は製品ラインごとに異なると述べるにとどまる。qualification/certification/switching の堀記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: because we have a long product design and development cycle for most of our products and prospective customers typically require lengthy product qualification periods prior to placing volume orders, we may be unable to replace these customers quickly or at all
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。顧客が長期の製品認定期間を課すのは既存の要件として断定され、材料変更時は『the risks associated with qualifying new polymers with our customers』＝顧客側で再認定が要ると明記。ただし2018年版の『requalification by our customers』ほど直截ではなく、認定支援の記述（field engineers が顧客工場で product qualification）は願望形型に近い点は留保。

rows.quote: The market for IT services is highly competitive, and we expect competition to persist and intensify.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。競合にインド系大手を実名列挙し、顧客の社内IT部門も競合と自認。競争要因に price を含む。移行障壁の主張なし。

rows.quote: All of the Company's properties are located in developed areas that include other multifamily properties. The number of competitive multifamily properties in a particular area could have a material effect on the Company's ability to lease apartment units at its properties and on the rents charged.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。戸建・他形態の賃貸も居住者の代替手段と自認。年次リースで移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: There is competition in all classes of products manufactured by the Company from divisions of the largest electronic companies, as well as many small companies. The Company's sales do not represent a significant share of the industry's market for any class of its products.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。防衛向けだが競争方法の筆頭が price で、競合が『aggressively investing in upfront product design costs and lowering profit margins』と自認。AS9100 は当社が取得する側の認証＝規約で85に当たらない。

rows.note: アパートREIT。原本は代替住居が多数あると明言し、移行障壁・認定の記述は皆無（賃借人は毎年更新で移れる）。堀は西海岸の供給制約という立地要因で、irrの型ではない。

rows.quote: Customers representing approximately 99% of our 2013 revenue continued to be customers in 2014, due to the "mission-critical" and embedded nature of the services provided and the high switching costs associated with these services.
rows.note: 高スイッチングコスト＋mission-critical組込＋複数年契約を断定するが、顧客側の再認定の記述は無い＝70。'only provider of EBT services to the Puerto Rican government' は単一顧客の随意契約であり『その用途に他の供給者が存在しない』ではないので100に当たらない。card association の certification は当社が取得する側。

rows.quote: Barriers to entry in each industry are low, except with respect to environmental permitting requirements for new aggregates production facilities and zoning of land to permit mining and extraction of aggregates.
rows.note: セメント・壁材。原本自ら参入障壁は低い・製品はコモディティで競争は主に価格と述べる（'competition among manufacturers is based largely on price'）。認定・組込の記述なし。

rows.note: フォワーダー。原本は激烈競争に加え『Customers regularly solicit bids from competitors』と顧客が定期入札すると明記＝移行摩擦の反証。堀は文化・ネットワーク密度で、irrの型ではない。

rows.quote: We compete with other producers of biodiesel, both locally, regionally, and nationally. The principal methods of competition in the biodiesel industry are price, supply reliability, biodiesel quality, and RIN integrity
rows.note: バイオ燃料はコモディティで価格競争（自社も『biodiesel is a commodity with a large potential customer base』と述べる）。特殊化学は受託製造だが、原本の 'qualif' 出現は税制優遇・ASTM規格・人材のみで、顧客の再認定・工程認定の記述はゼロ。ISO9001は自社取得の認証。

rows.quote: The investment management business is highly competitive. Competition is particularly intense among mutual fund providers. According to the Investment Company Institute, at the end of 2014 , there were approximately 7,900 open-end mutual funds of varying sizes and investment objectives whose shares are currently being offered to the public
rows.note: 資産運用。原本が7,900本の競合ファンドと代替商品（保険・銀行・ETF・ヘッジファンド）を列挙＝代替容易。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: For banks and other potential clients of our financial information software and services, switching from one vendor of bank core processing or related software and services (or from an internally-developed system) to a new vendor is a significant undertaking. Many potential clients perceive potential disadvantages such as loss of accustomed functionality, increased costs (including conversion costs) and business disruption. As a result, potential clients may resist change.
rows.note: 銀行コア処理の乗り換えコスト（conversion cost・業務断絶）を顧客側の負担として断定＝典型的な70。VISA/MasterCard の certification は当社が取得・維持する側なので85には当たらない。

rows.quote: Price, location, rental space availability, flexibility of design, and property management services are the major factors that affect competition in the flexible warehouse/office rental market. The Company experiences considerable competition in all of its markets.
rows.note: タンクローリー輸送＋倉庫賃貸。輸送側も『two to six major tank truck competitors in each of its markets』で価格・サービス競争。認定・組込の記述なし。

rows.quote: Numerous commercial developers and real estate companies compete with us with respect to the leasing and the acquisition of properties. Some of these competitors may possess greater capital resources than we do
rows.note: 商業REIT。'high barriers to entry' は立地の開発難易度であって顧客（テナント）側の移行負担ではない。テナントはオンライン等の代替に晒されると原本自ら述べる。

rows.quote: The global apparel retail industry is highly competitive. We compete with local, national, and global apparel retailers.
rows.note: アパレル小売。顧客はエンド消費者で移行摩擦ゼロ。原本に認定・組込・スイッチングコストの記述なし。

rows.quote: Our Marine Systems group has one primary competitor with which it also partners on the Virginia-class submarine program. The operating cycle of many of our major platform programs can result in sustained periods of program continuity when we perform successfully.
rows.note: プラットフォーム計画への深い統合と長い運用サイクル＝継続性はあるが、顧客側が別供給者を再認定する費用の断定は無い（'incumbency on core programs' も自社の地位の話）。ガルフストリームのFAA/EASA type certification は当社が取得する側なので85に当たらない。

rows.quote: The consumer foods industry is highly competitive, with numerous manufacturers of varying sizes in the United States and throughout the world. The food categories in which we participate are also very competitive.
rows.note: 食品。多数の製造業者＋PB・ジェネリックとの価格競争を原本が明記。堀はブランドで、移行障壁・認定の記述はない。

rows.quote: Corning competes across all of its product lines with many large and varied manufacturers, both domestic and foreign. Some of these competitors are larger than Corning, and some have broader product lines.
rows.note: 全文696千字を qualif/design-in/switching で走査したが、顧客側の再認定も設計組込の断定も一つも無い（'qualif' は年金・ストックオプション・人材のみ）。ディスプレイ用ガラスは旭硝子・日電硝子と競合し光通信は 'price pressure' と自認＝代替側。堀は材料科学・工程技術だがirrの型では写らない。

rows.quote: Although a relatively small number of large competitors hold a significant portion of the paperboard packaging market, the Company's business is subject to strong competition. There are two major CUK producers in the U.S. - MeadWestvaco Corporation and the Company.
rows.note: 板紙包装。集中構造（CUKは米国2社）は市場構造＝domの話で、原本は強い競争と『product substitution』（SBS・CCN等の他素材への代替）を自ら挙げる＝irrは代替容易側。認定・組込の記述なし。

rows.quote: Our stations also compete for advertising revenue with other media, such as newspapers, radio stations, magazines, outdoor advertising, transit advertising, yellow page directories, direct mail, internet websites, and local cable and other MVPD systems.
rows.note: 地方テレビ局。広告主は他媒体へ随時移れると原本が列挙し、視聴者もMVPD・ネットへ流れると述べる＝代替容易。FCC免許は当社が保有する側の許認可で、顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: The facilities maintenance industry is highly fragmented, and changes in competition could result in decreased demand for Grainger's products and services. There are several large competitors in the industry, although most of the market is served by small local and regional competitors.
rows.note: 原本が市場を自ら fragmented と断定し、製造業者・卸・カタログ・小売・ネット業者と全市場で競合すると述べる。顧客側の再認定・移行摩擦の記述は一つも無い＝残余の刻み50。

rows.quote: Our industry is highly competitive, with competition based primarily on customer service, price, store location and appearance, and quality, availability and assortment of merchandise.

rows.note: ネットリースREIT。資産取得で多数の同等資本と競合すると原本が述べる。12年平均残存の長期リースはあるが、テナント側の再認定・移行費用の記述は無く、qualification/certificationの語は全てREIT税務要件とSOX証明書の話。

rows.quote: The restaurant industry and the retail food industry in general are very competitive with respect to convenience, price, product quality and service.
rows.note: 原本(FY2014 10-K)は競争の激しさを自認し、リスク項目でも『Competition from larger companies. The Company competes for franchise and license sales with large national companies and numerous regional and local companies. Many of its competitors have greater financial and other resources than the Company.』と述べる。移行障壁・認定の記述は一つも無い。

rows.quote: We compete in a rapidly evolving and highly competitive industry, and expect competition will continue to intensify as consolidations and mergers occur within the industry.
rows.note: ILEC(地域電話)だが原本自身がCATV/衛星/VoIP/無線の競合と『Alternatives to our service include customers leasing private line switched voice and data services…that permit the bypassing of our communications facilities』を挙げる。規制独占の断定は無い＝業種でなく本文で50。

rows.quote: If OEMs, ODMs, and AIB and motherboard manufacturers do not include our products in their systems, they will typically not use our products in their systems until at least the next design configuration.
rows.note: 設計組込(design win)の摩擦は述べるが、全体は『In order to achieve design wins, we must…』の願望形。顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ。唯一の'certified by'は『suppliers that are certified by the International Organization for Standardization』＝当社のサプライヤ側で向きが逆。市場は『intensely competitive…declining average selling prices』と自認。

rows.quote: The process of obtaining new charters is highly competitive, generally involves an intensive screening process and competitive bids, and often extends for several months.
rows.note: 20-F。参入障壁には言及するが同じ文で『While there are some barriers to entry…new entrants have entered the market over the last five years』と自ら否定。認証はISM/ISO等の当社取得側のみ＝85に当たらない。

rows.quote: The entertainment and television industries are highly competitive and are undergoing a period of consolidation. Many of our current and potential competitors have greater financial, marketing, programming and broadcasting resources than we do.
rows.note: FCC免許はあるが当社が取得する側で、広告主・視聴者ともに他媒体へ容易に移る旨を原本が列挙。顧客側の再認定・移行費用の記述なし。

rows.quote: In addition, we continued to work closely with customers evaluating and qualifying our proprietary PHOLED materials for commercial usage in both displays and lighting products, and with other material suppliers to match our PHOLED emitters with their phosphorescent hosts and other OLED materials.
rows.note: 材料が顧客の量産工程で評価・認定される型だが、引用は『we continued to work closely with customers evaluating and qualifying』＝願望形で、顧客側が再認定費用を負う断定は無い。堀の主張は自社の特許束（『Our existing fundamental phosphorescent OLED patents expire in the United States in 2017 and 2019』）＝自社取得のIPゆえ85に当たらない。

rows.quote: Our customers' medication control systems are mission critical to their success and our customers require these systems to be functional at all times.
rows.note: 病院に設置済みの調剤自動化システム＋1/2/5年の保守契約＋院内情報システムとの統合＝移行摩擦は実在（installed baseの61%がG4へアップグレード）。ただし顧客側の再認定の記述は無く、Competition節は『The medication management and supply chain solutions market is intensely competitive』。

rows.quote: The supply of vehicles from dealers is dispersed among all of the auctions in the used vehicle market.
rows.note: CIK1395942の原本はKAR Auction Services名義（同一法人の改称でOPLNへ。後年情報は使わずcikで同定）。『High Barriers to Entry』の一般論はあるが顧客側の負担は書かれておらず85に当たらない。出品者は複数オークションへ分散し、ネット業者や顧客自身の直販が新競合として挙がる。

rows.quote: The market for computer and network security solutions is very competitive and, like most technology-driven markets, is subject to rapid change and constantly evolving products and services.
rows.note: 原本(VASCO名義・同一法人)は主要競合をGemalto/RSA等と名指しし、さらに設計方針として『we incorporate industry-accepted, open and non-proprietary protocols. This permits interoperability』＝自らロックを弱める側。移行障壁・認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: The decision by a customer to license our software products or purchase our services often involves a comprehensive implementation process across the customer's network or networks. As a result, the licensing and implementation of our software products and any related services may entail a significant commitment of resources by prospective customers, accompanied by the attendant risks and delays frequently associated with significant technology implementation projects.
rows.note: 全社ネットワーク規模の導入負担＋『Customers often use our services and solutions for critical business processes』＝深い統合による移行摩擦。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、Competition節は『The market for our products and services is highly competitive』。

rows.quote: The business of selling brand name consumer products in the OTC Healthcare and Household Cleaning categories is highly competitive. These markets include numerous national and global manufacturers, distributors, marketers and retailers that actively compete for consumers' business both in the United States and abroad.
rows.note: 原本自身が『increased competition from "private label" products introduced by major retail chains』を挙げ、消費者側の代替は容易。製造は95社の第三者委託。移行障壁・認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: As the competition for high-credit-quality tenants is intense, we may be required to provide rent abatements, incur charges for tenant improvements and other concessions, or we may not be able to lease vacant space timely, all of which would adversely impact our results of operations.
rows.note: オフィスREIT。原本は『We face considerable competition in the leasing market and may be unable to renew existing leases or re-let space on terms similar to the existing leases』とも述べ、テナントの移行障壁は自ら否定的。認定・規格ロックの記述なし。

rows.quote: A New Jersey corporation, incorporated in 1924, which is a franchised public utility in New Jersey. It is also the provider of last resort for gas and electric commodity service for end users in its service territory.
rows.note: 収益の柱PSE&Gは『designated service territory』の franchised public utility ＝送配電に代替供給者が存在しない構造。留保2点を明記する——原本は『All electric and gas customers in New Jersey have the ability to choose their own electric energy and/or gas supplier』とコモディティ側の選択自由を明言（ただし当社は『we make no margin on the default supply』）、かつ発電のPSEG Powerは『We face significant competition in the merchant energy markets』。

rows.quote: Laws in the U.S. generally allow, and in some cases require, pharmacists to substitute, for brand-name drugs, generic drugs that have been rated under government procedures to be chemically and therapeutically equivalent to brand-name drugs.
rows.note: 特許は当社が取得する側のIPで85に当たらず、しかも原本は主要薬の特許失効年を表で列挙し『Our products face competition in the form of branded or generic drugs that treat similar diseases or indications』と述べる。政府手続で同等と格付けされた後発品への置換が法で許容・一部強制＝代替容易の明示。

rows.quote: Competitive Condition . The markets in which our products are sold are highly competitive. Our products compete against similar products of many large and small companies, including well-known global competitors. In many of the markets and industry segments in which we sell our products, we compete against other branded products as well as retailers' private-label brands.
rows.note: 巨大ブランドと流通規模は強いが、irr欄が問う移行障壁については原本自身が『increasing competition from mid- and lower-tier value products』『retailers' private-label brands』と代替容易を述べる。顧客側の再認定・組込の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: The Company's customers frequently require that the Company's products undergo an extensive qualification process, which may include testing for performance, structural integrity and reliability. This qualification process may be lengthy and does not assure any sales of the product to that customer.
rows.note: 顧客が当社製品を長期の認定試験に掛ける記述はあるが、負担は当社側（『devotes substantial resources』『no assurance of sales』）で、顧客が替える際に再認定を要するとは書かれていない→70。FAA認定に絡む供給源変更の制約の記述は当社が原材料を買う側の話（向きが逆）。

rows.quote: Generally, the Company and each of its customers engage in a qualification and correlation process before the Company becomes an approved supplier.
rows.note: 承認供給者になるための認定・相関工程は明記されるが、同じ原本が『most of the Company's customers utilize multiple photomask suppliers』『pressure to reduce prices』と述べ、ノード移行で認定を失った実例まで記す→顧客側の再認定負担の断定は無く70。

rows.quote: We primarily compete with regional manufacturers of snow and ice control equipment for light trucks. While we are the most geographically diverse company in our industry, we may face increasing competition in the markets in which we operate. In saturated markets, price competition may lead to a decrease in our market share or a compression of our margins, both of which would affect our profitability.
rows.note: 認定・規格・設計組込の記述はゼロ。地域メーカーとの価格競争を原本が自認→50。堀はブランドと販売店網（ただし原本は『Price competition among our distributors could negatively affect our market share』とも書く）。

rows.quote: Our products are generally incorporated into a customer's products at the design stage. However, customer decisions to use our products, commonly referred to as design wins, can often require us to expend significant research and development and sales and marketing resources without any assurance of success.
rows.note: 典型的な設計組込（design win）＋長い販売サイクル＝70。ただし記述は願望形（『We cannot assure that we will continue to achieve design wins』）で、顧客側の再認定・再試験の負担は一切書かれていない。原本自ら『intensely competitive and characterized by significant price sensitivity』とも述べる。

rows.quote: Our theme parks and other product and entertainment offerings compete directly for discretionary spending with other destination and regional theme parks and water and amusement parks and indirectly with other types of recreational facilities and forms of entertainment, including movies, home entertainment options, sports attractions, restaurants and vacation travel.
rows.note: 認定・規格ロックの記述なし（'certification'は乗物整備の社内訓練とSOX証明のみ）。可処分所得を巡り代替娯楽と直接・間接に競合と原本が明記→50。

rows.quote: Most of our facilities compete with other nearby self-storage facilities that use the same marketing channels we use, including Internet advertising, signage, and banners, and offer the same service we do. As a result, competition is significant and affects the occupancy levels, rental rates, rental income and operating expenses of our facilities. While competition is significant, the self-storage industry remains fragmented in the U.S.
rows.note: 近隣施設が『同じ役務を提供する』・業界はfragmentedと原本が明言＝代替容易の典型→50。移行障壁・認定の記述は皆無（'certified'は監査証明の文脈のみ）。

rows.quote: We face various competitive factors against greater adoption of our products, in particular the use of "home-brew" or lab-developed methods, where widely available reagents and other chemicals are used in a non-standardized manner to perform sample and assay processing.
rows.note: 広く入手可能な試薬による自家調製法が代替として存在し『The markets for some of our products are very competitive and price sensitive』と原本が述べる→50。取得認証はISO9001/13485とFDA承認＝自社が取得する側で85には当たらない。顧客側の再バリデーション負担の記述なし。

rows.quote: Our businesses that engage in video and online commerce compete with traditional bricks-and-mortar and online retailers ranging from large department stores to specialty shops, electronic retailers, direct marketing retailers, such as mail order and catalog companies, and discount retailers.
rows.note: 小売の全形態と競合と原本が列挙。認定・規格・設計組込の記述はゼロ（'certification'はSOX証明のみ）→50。

rows.quote: Product Qualifications. Many of the products we produce are qualified for the application by the OEM, the U.S. Department of Defense, the FAA or a combination of these agencies. These credentials have been achieved for thousands of distinct items after years of design, testing and improvement.
rows.note: 第三者（OEM・DoD・FAA）が用途ごとに当社製品を認定する型の断定で、既に取得済み（『in excess of 44,100 of such approvals』『in many of these instances we are the only approved supplier of a given bearing product』）＝85。唯一供給の主張は製品単位の限定付きなので100は取らない。

rows.quote: The staffing services business is highly competitive and, because it is a service business, the barriers to entry are quite low. There are many competitors, some of which have greater resources than the Company, and new competitors are entering the market all the time. In addition, long-term contracts form a negligible portion of the Company's revenue.
rows.note: 参入障壁が低い・競合多数・長期契約はごく僅か、と原本が自認＝代替容易の教科書例→50。

rows.quote: We face intense competition from other domestic and foreign fashion-oriented apparel, footwear, accessory, and casual apparel producers, some of which may be significantly larger and more diversified and may have greater financial and marketing resources than us.
rows.note: アパレルの激烈な競争と価格圧力（『significant pricing pressure ... a highly promotional environment』）を原本が明記→50。'certification'は自社のベンダー認証プログラム＝当社が供給者を認定する側で向きが逆。

rows.quote: Factors that influence our competitive position include the breadth of our product portfolio and scope of solutions, technology differentiation, knowledge of customer applications, installed base, distribution network, quality of products and services, global presence and price.
rows.note: 設置ベースを競争力の源泉に挙げ『integrated control and information architecture, with Logix at its core』と深い統合を述べる→70。顧客側の再認定の記述は無く、Siemens/ABB/Schneider等の大手を競合に名指しするので85・100には届かない。

rows.quote: We face intense competition from numerous competitors. Our products compete primarily on the basis of product quality, performance, innovation, technology, price, applications expertise, system and service flexibility and established customer service capabilities.
rows.note: ニッチ市場の首位を自称するが（順位の自称は証拠にならない）、認定・規格ロック・設計組込・スイッチングコストの記述は全文走査でゼロ。多数の競合と価格を含む要素で競うと原本が述べる→50。

rows.quote: We conduct our business in highly competitive markets, and all of our major products face competition from local, regional and national firms. Our markets, however, are fragmented, and we do not face competition across all of our products from any one competitor in particular.
rows.note: 市場はfragmentedで地域・全国の多数企業と競合と原本が明言→50。認定・移行障壁の記述なし（'certification'はSOX証明と訴訟手続のみ）。

rows.quote: Timber markets in our Southern and Pacific Northwest regions are relatively fragmented. In the Southern region, we compete with Plum Creek Timber Company, Weyerhaeuser Company and TIMOs such as Hancock Timber Resource Group, Resource Management Service
rows.note: 市場はfragmentedで『In all markets, price is the principal method of competition』＝完全な商品市場→50。SFI/FSC認証は当社が取得する側なので85には当たらない。

rows.quote: We operate in a highly competitive broadcast and media business. We compete for listeners, advertisers and customers with other radio broadcasters, as well as with other forms of media including broadcast and cable television, newspapers and magazines, book publishers, national and local digital services, outdoor advertising, direct mail, online marketing and media companies, social media platforms, web-based blogs, and mobile devices.
rows.note: COMPETITION節は聴取者・広告主を多数の代替メディアと奪い合うと述べるのみ。移行障壁・顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ（'certification'のヒットは全てSOX証明書）。FCC免許は自社が取得する側で規約の除外対象。

rows.quote: The beauty products distribution industry is highly fragmented, and there are few significant barriers to entry into the marketplaces for most of the types of products and services we sell.
rows.note: 原本自身がfragmented＋参入障壁ほぼ無しと断定＝50の残余刻みが両側から確定。BSGの独占販売テリトリーは仕入側の権利で、顧客の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: We have historically experienced price competition from independent funeral home and cemetery operators, monument dealers, casket retailers, low-cost funeral providers, and other nontraditional providers of merchandise and services.
rows.note: Competition節は「北米の葬祭業の大半は地元の独立事業者」「当社シェア約16%」＋価格競争の自認。立地・評判が競争要因で、顧客側の再認定・切替費用の記述は無い。

rows.quote: Both radio and television broadcasting are highly competitive businesses. Our stations compete for listeners/viewers and advertising revenues directly with other radio and/or television stations, as well as other media, within their markets.
rows.note: 広告主・聴取者は他局と他メディアへ自由に移れると原本が述べる。新メディア（衛星・ネット配信）からの競争も自認。移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: Jewelry retailing is highly fragmented and competitive. We compete against other specialty jewelers as well as other retailers that sell jewelry, including department stores, mass merchandisers, discount stores, apparel and accessory fashion stores, brand retailers, shopping clubs, home shopping television channels, direct home sellers and online retailers and auction sites.
rows.note: 原本が'highly fragmented'と市場構造そのものを断定＝50確定。自社発行のクレジットや店舗ブランドはあるが、顧客の切替費用・再認定の記述は一切ない（'certified by'のヒットはダイヤ保証の店員点検）。

rows.quote: In most cases once we secure a Design Win our customer will continue to buy our cards for as long as it continues to sell its server based system.
rows.note: OEMの機器へ設計組込され、評価・qualificationに12ヶ月以上を要すると原本が述べる（E長期認定期間の要素もある）。ただし顧客側の再認定を要する断定は無く、逆に『次世代機で当社カードが選ばれない可能性』を自らリスクとして挙げるので85には届かない。

rows.quote: We work closely with major foundries to ensure that our EDA, IP, and manufacturing solutions are compatible with their manufacturing processes.
rows.note: 設計フローへの深い統合・複数年TSL・長い顧客評価承認プロセスはあるが、顧客側の再認定の断定は無い。ファウンドリ連携の記述は『work closely with』の願望形で、規約が85から明示除外する型。標準対応は『different vendorsのツール間の相互運用性を高める』と自らロックを弱める側を述べる。

rows.quote: The retail service rights of all electric suppliers in the State of Georgia are regulated by the Territorial Electric Service Act of 1973. Pursuant to the provisions of this Act, all areas within existing municipal limits were assigned to the primary electric supplier therein.
rows.note: 州法・PSCが供給区域を各社へ割当て済み＝当該区域の需要家に他の供給者が存在しない、と原本が述べる規制独占。留保: 900KW以上の新規需要家に一度きりの選択権がある旨も同じ節に明記。

rows.quote: The wireless messaging industry is highly competitive. Companies compete on the basis of price, coverage area, services offered, transmission quality, network reliability, and customer service.
rows.note: 主力のページング事業は携帯各社と代替競争にあり加入者減を自認。JITC certificationは当社が自ら取得し4年ごとに更新する認証＝規約が明示除外する『自社取得の認証』で、顧客側の負担ではない。

rows.quote: The market for financial services software and services is competitive, rapidly evolving and highly sensitive to new product introductions and marketing efforts by industry participants, although high conversion costs can create barriers to adoption of new products or technologies.
rows.note: 『high conversion costs』＝顧客が乗り換えに費用を払うと原本が断定＝スイッチングコスト型で70。ただし同じ文が市場はfragmentedで内製ITとも競合すると述べ、顧客側の再認定・再試験の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The technology-driven, highly customized, and integrated nature of our products require customers to invest heavily in certification and qualification to ensure proper functioning of the system in which our products are embedded. We believe the capital commitment and time required for this process significantly increases the switching costs for customers once a particular sensor or control has been designed and installed in a system.
rows.note: 顧客の側が認証・適格性評価に多額を投じ、しかも『Where our component parts are detailed in our customers' certifications from Underwriters' Laboratories, changes to their certifications may be necessary in order for them to incorporate competitors' motor protection offerings.』＝競合品を採用するには顧客が自らのUL認証を変更する必要があると明記。『often government or customer mandated』の多年認定も併記＝85の核心そのもの。

rows.quote: We operate in a highly competitive market for investment opportunities.
rows.note: 商業用不動産債権の投資会社。資本は完全な代替可能財で、競合が低い資金コストを持ちうると自認。顧客の移行障壁・認定の概念自体が原本に無い（'qualification'は全てREIT税務要件）。

rows.quote: The beverage alcohol industry is highly competitive. We compete on the basis of quality, price, brand recognition and distribution strength.
rows.note: 消費者はアルコール・非アルコール飲料へ自由に代替できると原本が述べる。メキシコビールブランドの永久的独占サブライセンスは強い資産だが、これは商標の排他権であって顧客側の再認定・切替費用ではない（moat5には反映）。

rows.quote: The hotel industry is highly competitive. Generally our hotels are located in areas that include other hotels.
rows.note: 外部運用のホテル・トラベルセンターREIT。宿泊客の移行障壁はゼロと原本が述べる。'requalif'のヒットはREIT資格の再取得の話で堀とは無関係。

rows.quote: Most of the Company’s customers do not buy their entire flavor and/or fragrance products from a single supplier and the Company does not compete with a single supplier in all product categories.
rows.note: 顧客は複数調達が常態と原本が明記し『All Company products are sold in highly competitive markets.』とも述べる。処方の作り込みはあるが顧客側の再処方・再認定の記述は無く、ISO9000は自社取得の認証で規約の除外対象。

rows.quote: The markets in which we operate are highly competitive, and new products and surgical procedures are introduced on an ongoing basis. Such marketplace changes may cause some of our products to become obsolete.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K の Competition/Risk Factors を全走査。顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコストの記述はゼロで、認証は 510(k) と自社特許約1,900件＝いずれも当社が取得する側。原本は製品陳腐化と激しい競争を自認するので50。

rows.quote: The private education market in China is rapidly evolving, highly fragmented and competitive, and we expect competition to persist and intensify.
rows.note: FY2015/2(20-F)。市場が fragmented と原本が明言し、生徒は随時退講・返金請求できると自ら書く。認定・移行障壁の記述なし＝50。

rows.quote: As long as customers receive products that meet or exceed expectations and performance standards, we believe that they will have a reduced incentive to certify another supplier because of the cost and time of the technical design and testing certification process.
rows.note: 2018年ビンテージと一字同型の機構文が FY2014 10-K に既に存在。加えて『we and the components we manufacture must be certified by the FAA, the DOD and similar agencies in foreign countries and by individual manufacturers』＝第三者＋OEMが用途ごとに認定し、替えるコストは顧客側に落ちる。

rows.quote: The biotechnology and clinical control industries are very competitive, more so recently due to consolidation trends. The Company faces significant competition across all of its product lines and in each market in which it operates.
rows.note: FY2014/6 10-K。抗体・試薬の validation は自社が行う側で、顧客の再認定・再試験の記述は無い。中国等の低コスト製造業者の参入で価格圧力が増していると自認＝50。

rows.quote: Some of our competitors have introduced or announced new products with certain performance characteristics which may be considered equal or superior to those we currently offer.

rows.note: 原本自身が『intensely competitive』かつ『vast number of competitors』で自社は業界の有意な部分を占めないと述べる＝代替容易の断定。certification/qualification は全て労働訴訟のクラス認定の文脈で堀と無関係。franchise agreement・trademark・proprietary menu items は当社側の資産で顧客側の再認定負担の記述は皆無。供給側も『alternative sources for most of these products are generally available』

Competition in the digital media space is fierce and continues to intensify.
rows.note: 会社自身が『similar or alternative services』への顧客の実際の乗り換えを認めており代替容易。Business Cloud Services の競合列挙も広範（fax/PBX/email/バックアップ等）。certification のヒットはSOX302の署名証明のみ。integrat/retention のヒットも自社サービスの機能説明と解約率リスクの話で、顧客側の再認定・再試験の記述は一つも無い
